data.one_liner: A lazy‑loading IndexedStack widget for Flutter that loads pages only when first shown.
data.what_it_does: ProsteIndexedStack behaves like the standard IndexedStack but creates each child only when it becomes visible for the first time. It also offers an optional preload flag for specific children.
use_when: You want to keep multiple pages in memory but avoid building them all at startup
You need a drop‑in replacement for IndexedStack with lazy loading to improve initial load performance
avoid_when: All pages must be built immediately
You require complex navigation or animated transitions between pages
strengths: Reduces initial build cost by loading pages lazily
Simple API that mirrors IndexedStack usage
Allows selective preloading of specific children
weaknesses: Requires wrapping each child in IndexedStackChild
First‑time switch may be delayed in debug mode
Limited to lazy loading; no built‑in animation support
data.minimal_example:
ProsteIndexedStack(
  index: _current,
  children: [
    IndexedStackChild(child: HomePage()),
    IndexedStackChild(child: Page2()),
    IndexedStackChild(child: Page3(), preload: true),
    IndexedStackChild(child: Page4()),
  ],
)
